intro.name: I'm Sean
intro.greeting: Welcome to my personal portfolio website.
intro.freelance: Front-end specialist, full-stack when it counts

about.p1: Based in Paris, I'm a trilingual front-end developer (French, English, German) with a background in teaching and professional communication. I moved into web development in 2022, and front-end has been my focus ever since, with backend fundamentals (Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL) picked up along the way.
about.p2: In 2023, I joined a two-year work-study program, working at Abeille Assurances as a front-end developer / web integrator. I worked on high-visibility projects there, helping evolve design systems and keep the UI consistent across large platforms.
about.p3: React, Next.js, and TypeScript are where I spend most of my time: building component libraries, wiring up state, and sweating the details that make an interface feel solid. I'm just as comfortable with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL when a feature calls for a REST API, an auth flow, or a database schema, but the front-end is where I go deep.
about.p4: I care about accessibility and long-term maintainability as much as visual polish, whether that's structuring a component library, refining a design system, or making sure a modal works as well for a screen reader as it does for a mouse. Getting there means collaborating closely with product, UX, and back-end teams.
about.p5: I finished my M2 in Software Development (RNCP 7) at OpenClassrooms and I'm now looking for a full-time front-end role (CDI), ideally somewhere that treats component architecture, accessibility, and design systems as more than an afterthought.
